name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop app: a thin Electron shell around the dsh web runtime, with an independently updatable harness bundle.
author: DeepSeek Harness Desktop

scripts.dist:portable: npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable
scripts.release: npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
